decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the firm's core map.apps platform and is being actively developed, with four releases in four weeks, so it has low maintenance cost and clear value for existing customers.
The hierarchical search bundle is a small reusable plugin close to the core offer and costs little to keep in the portfolio.
VueTOC improves mobile usability of map apps and was promoted on the home page, but as an experimental component it could later be folded into the main product.
The GIS solution platform is central to the firm's strategy of reusable enterprise architectures, so dropping it is unlikely.
Mobile field data capture meets steady demand from public-sector and utility customers and fits the firm's integrated offer.
The search extension is a core function in web map apps and is cheap to maintain alongside the platform.
